note.question: What determines assortment and pricing problems when customers purchase products according to a nonparametric choice model?
note.overview: The model considers assortment and pricing problems when customers purchase products according to a nonparametric choice model. Each customer arrives with a preference list and will purchase the highest-ranking offered product in her preference list. We assume the set of customer classes is derived from paths in a tree, in which the order of nodes visited along each path gives the corresponding preference list.
